decision.primary: TX precision vs RAW for source-fixed weak pair1/3; TX_RX_DAY explanatory only
decision.rule: All3 existing BASE model seeds: crossRX class-difference signal positive, SNR>=1.10xRAW and each weakTX RXspread/signal<=.95xRAW. This only motivates a separately preregistered L-only feature-loss study, never classifier substitution or target benefit.

limitations: Read-only scatter statistics in seen source receivers; not fitted default-head or prototype predictions.
Three model seeds share the same source packets; A/B/C have disjoint cache rows, not independent acquisition conditions.
A estimates covariance; only B/C estimate signals and RX dispersion. No V-derived matrix enters training or deployment.
Fixed shrinkage and bounded precision are descriptive hypotheses, not a guaranteed Fisher-optimal model or target improvement.
